what: Every dated row in CORRECTIONS.md, counted. The page says self-correction is only evidence if it is countable; this is the count.
outward_facing_note: Rows whose text refers to an email, deck, one-pager, README, public page, headline or VERDICT row -- corrections that reached, or would have reached, someone outside this repository. A typo fixed in a private note is housekeeping; withdrawing a number already sent to a stranger is the part that costs something, and it is the only part worth citing.
how_counted: A row counts only if its first cell opens with an ISO date. Header rows, alignment rows and prose tables are excluded by construction, so adding a section cannot inflate the count.
what_this_does_not_show: A high count is not self-evidently good and must not be sold as though it were. It is consistent with a careful instrument and equally consistent with a project that published too fast the first time. The defensible reading is narrower: these are errors that were found HERE, by this process, and published with dates, rather than found by a reader later. It says nothing about the errors still standing.
